chapter: A musical family and the old New Orleans bands
title: Manuel Perez joins Charlie Elgar in Chicago; Uncle Willie names the heroes
summary: Perez, the reading Creole trumpeter, went to Chicago, and Willie whispered the names of Perez, Petit, Rena and Kelly to Danny.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Now, there was Manuel Perez, who was the top trumpet player around here, Downtown. Like, everybody respected him as a reading musician. He went to Chicago. He went up there and joined Charlie Elgar's band.
He had a society type band, didn't he.

Yes. And that was... You looked up on him; you saw him in the street. And these people were all celebrated when you'd see as a kid. My little uncle, Willie, would whisper [SOTTO VOCE] "That's Mister Manuel Perez. That's Mister Buddy Petit. That's Kid Rena. That's Chris Kelly. That's ...(?)...." (?) had this great band, you'd hear him. And I'm listening to all that.
